summary: SMOKE test post-Gemini-migration PASSED. The user-reported 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not configured' error is RESOLVED: both the direct API call POST /api/admin/ai/one-click-product (via curl) and the admin UI One-Click AI Product button no longer emit the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY error. Text generation via Gemini succeeded end-to-end for a test product (name/tagline/description/concerns/ingredients/benefits all returned). Homepage, /shop, and /product/anti-aging-serum render correctly. One caveat observed: when the UI triggers one-click WITH generate_image:true, the request crossed the Cloudflare/ingress ~55s window and the browser received a 502 origin-timeout alert — the Gemini-image path is slow enough to flirt with ingress timeouts in the preview env. This is NOT a regression of the Gemini fix (text-only path works; backend curl of image path reportedly completes in ~51s per main agent).

minor.issue: Request from browser via Cloudflare returned 502 after ~55s. Direct curl (per main agent) completes in ~51s. Risk of ingress timeout for image-generation path — consider async/background job + polling.

ui_bugs.issue: 1 broken image on each page (home 1/48, shop 1/15, product 1/8). Pre-existing from iteration_3; identical count/behaviour.

integration_issues.issue: UI uses axios without an explicit timeout and request can exceed Cloudflare/ingress ~55s limit → user sees 'origin returned invalid or incomplete response' alert instead of success. No test product leaked (verified via /api/admin/products listing after run).

action_items: Consider converting /api/admin/ai/one-click-product (with generate_image=true) to an async job pattern (job id + polling) to avoid Cloudflare 55-60s edge timeouts. Alternatively, let user generate text first and image in a second quick call.
Investigate the single stale image on homepage/shop/product (naturalWidth===0) — same URL as iteration_3; may be a lazyload race or a legitimately missing asset.
(Minor) Replace browser window.prompt chain in One-Click AI Product with a proper modal form for better UX and testability.
critical_code_review_comments: Gemini migration looks clean: GeminiChat drop-in used uniformly across routes/services, Emergent key is now optional fallback.
Admin One-Click AI uses sequential window.prompt() calls — fragile, not accessible, blocks keyboard flow, and hard to test. Consider a form modal.
Frontend axios call for one-click product has no explicit timeout; recommend adding a long timeout plus a user-visible progress indicator for 50s+ generations.

success_rate.backend: 100% (one-click text path, admin login, product listing, delete)
success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (home/shop/product/admin-login/one-click-no-emergent-error); image-generation UX degraded due to ingress timeout

seed_data_creation: None persistent. A test product 'test-hyaluronic-acid-moisturizer' was created once via curl and deleted immediately after verification. The frontend-triggered run timed out at the edge and no product was persisted (verified empty admin products list afterwards).
context_for_next_testing_agent: User's EMERGENT_LLM_KEY bug is verified fixed. The remaining concern is a Cloudflare 55s edge timeout when the One-Click AI Product UI runs with image generation; backend itself works (curl ok in ~51s). If main agent moves image gen to an async job, next agent should re-verify both the UI flow and that products land in /api/admin/products.
rca of the issue: User's original bug: AI call sites required EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Main agent introduced GeminiChat (services/gemini_llm.py) and switched every call site to prefer GEMINI_API_KEY. Verified via (a) curl POST /api/admin/ai/one-click-product {generate_image:false} returned success:true with full Gemini-generated content, and (b) UI One-Click AI Product button flow — no 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not configured' error anywhere; alert body (when image path timed out) was a Cloudflare 502 message, not the key error. Fix confirmed.
